Maths makes magicA correct answer gives you a safe superboost. After one mistake, try again for a smaller boost. After two mistakes, see the answer and continue without a boost. Choose unlimited time, or 60, 30 or 15 seconds per question.

Follow the rainbow ramps onto high clouds and dragon backs, then jump between the roofs. A dragon without a rainbow path? Go around it! After a crash, solve a sum to save your ride, up to 3 times. Crash again within 5 seconds of a rescue and your ride is over.
